animal-whistle.x: Animal whistle can be used to summon [[horse|horse]] from anywhere outdoor on Coral Island.

lumina-wand.x: Lumina wand is a tool used to provide sunlight to [[ocean-crops|underwater crops]] on their [[underwater-farm|underwater farm]]. The crops need light every day in order to grow.
The lumina wand can be upgraded at the [[oracle-chamber|Oracle Chamber]].

The basic lumina wand allows the player to light one square of soil at a time. Once upgraded, it can light multiple tiles by holding the button used to light until it is charged. The lighted area is always located in the direction the player is facing.
All lumina wand upgrades consume 3 [[energy|energy]] per one tile per hit if any soil gets light and 1 energy if no squares get light at all. Upgrades are immediate upon purchase.

hoe.x: The hoe is a [[tool|tool]] mainly used for tilling soil to prepare it for [[farming|farming]], but can also be used to dig any soil or sand around the island in search of items. The hoe can also be used to dig up the [[clover|clover]]s that appear randomly throughout the map for a chance at rarer items, such as [[fossil|fossil nodes]] and [[coffer|coffer]]s.
The hoe can be upgraded at [[sanchez-brothers-blacksmith|Sanchez Brothers Blacksmith]] and [[enchanting|enchanted]] at Giants village.

The basic hoe allows the player to till one square of soil at a time. Once upgraded, it can be used to till multiple tiles by holding the button used to swing it until it is charged. The tilled area is always located in the direction the player is facing.

All hoes consume 3 [[energy|energy]] per tile hit if any soil gets tilled, and 1 energy if no squares get tilled at all. Leveling the [[farming|Farming]] mastery and gaining Farming Proficiency also reduces the energy cost per use.

milk-pail.x: [[milk-pail|Milk pail]] is a [[tool|tool]] that can be bought from the [[ranch|ranch]] to collect [[milk-group|milk]] from barn animals such as [[cow|cows]] and [[goat|goats]].

Milking animals with a milk pail grants [[ranching|ranching]] experience. The amount of experience depends on the quality of the product. Higher quality milk grants more experience than lower quality milk.

shears.x: [[shears|Shears]] is the tool that can be bought from the [[ranch|ranch]] to collect wool from barn animals such as sheep and llama.

axe.x: The axe is a [[tool|tool]] used to chop down [[trees|trees]], tree stumps, and large logs. The player starts the game with a basic axe that needs to be upgraded to chop down larger stumps and hardwood.

Axe can also be used to harvest crops from giant crops or fruits from fruit plants/trees, remove seed or fertilizer from tilled soil, weeds, crops, fruit plants/trees, equipment/traps that are currently not producing, taps that are attached to trees. Currently axe can't be used to remove sprinkler with attachment or ultimate scarecrow with skin.
The axe can be upgraded at [[sanchez-brothers-blacksmith|Sanchez Brothers Blacksmith]] and [[enchanting|enchanted]] at Giants village.

All axes consume 3 [[energy|energy]] per use if they hit a choppable tree or 1 energy if the hit fails. However, higher level axes do more damage per hit, allowing the player to spend their energy more effectively. Leveling the [[foraging|Foraging]] mastery and gaining Foraging Proficiency also reduces the energy cost per use.

pickaxe.x: The pickaxe is a [[tool|tool]] used to break stones, rocks, and meteors on the [[farm|farm]] and in the [[cavern|cavern]]. It can also be used to remove tilled soil, weeds, [[crop|crop]]s, placed [[farming|farming]] or [[artisan-product|artisan equipment]] (including sprinkler with attachment) or [[trap|traps]] that is currently not producing. Currently pickaxe can't be used to remove taps that are attached to trees or ultimate scarecrow with skin.

The pickaxe can be upgraded at [[sanchez-brothers-blacksmith|Sanchez Brothers Blacksmith]] and [[enchanting|enchanted]] at Giants village. An upgraded pickaxe deals more damage per hit and allows the player to break bigger and tougher rocks.

All pickaxes consume 3 [[energy|energy]] per use if they hit a breakable material or 1 energy if the hit fails. However, higher level pickaxes do more damage per hit, allowing the player to spend their energy more effectively. Leveling the [[mining|Mining]] mastery and gaining Mining Proficiency also reduces the energy cost per use.

scythe.x: The scythe is a [[tool|tool]] used to cut grass and weeds, harvest crops, and remove trash from around the island and underwater. Scythe can't be used to harvest giant crops or fruit plants/trees.
The scythe can be upgraded at [[sanchez-brothers-blacksmith|Sanchez Brothers Blacksmith]] and [[enchanting|enchanted]] at Giants village.

The basic scythe allows the player to cut one row of three tiles directly in front of them at a time. Once upgraded, it can be used to cut a larger area by holding the button used to swing it until it is charged. The cut area is always located in the direction the player is facing.

All scythes consume 3 energy per use if they hit cuttable grass or garbage, or no energy if the swing fails. However, higher level scythes do more damage per swing and have a wider swing area when charged, allowing the player to spend their energy more effectively. Leveling the [[diving|Diving]] mastery and gaining Diving Proficiency also reduces the energy cost per use.

watering-can.x: Watering can is a tool used to water [[crop|crop]]s the player plants on their [[farm|farm]]. The crops need to be watered every day in order to grow. It is not necessary to water crops when it [[weather|rains]]. The player can refill their watering can from any body of water nearby.
The watering can can be upgraded at [[sanchez-brothers-blacksmith|Sanchez Brothers Blacksmith]] and [[enchanting|enchanted]] at Giants village.

The basic watering can allows the player to water one square of soil at a time. Once upgraded, it can water multiple tiles by holding the button used to water until it is charged. The watered area is always located in the direction the player is facing.

All watering can consume 3 [[energy|energy]] per one tile per hit if any soil gets watered and 1 energy if no squares get watered at all. Leveling the [[farming|Farming]] mastery and gaining Farming Proficiency also reduces the energy cost per use.

fishing-pole.x: Fishing pole is an essential tool for [[fishing|catching fish]]. The player can use a fishing pole on any fishable body of water.
The player will receive their fishing pole from [[quest|Visit the Beach Shack quest]] for free and can upgrade it at Sunny's [[beach-shack|Beach Shack]].

All fishing rods cost 20 [[energy|energy]] to successfully catch a fish, or 1 energy for a failed cast or catching trash. Better fishing rods are more durable and allow the player to catch more difficult fish. Leveling the [[fishing|Fishing]] mastery and gaining Fishing Proficiency also reduces the energy cost per use.

bug-net.x: The bug net is a [[tool|tool]] used to [[catching|catch]] [[insect|insect]]s around the island and [[sea-critter|critter]]s in ocean.
The player will receive their first bug net from [[quest|Visit the Beach Shack quest]] for free and can upgrade it at Sunny's [[beach-shack|Beach Shack]].

All bug nets cost 20 [[energy|energy]] to successfully catch a bug or a critter, or 1 energy for a failed swing. Better bug nets have a wider catch radius and angle. Leveling the [[catching|Catching]] mastery and gaining Catching Proficiency also reduces the energy cost per use.
